result.title: Scenario Generalization and Sector Transfer in Real Surface Irrigation Surrogate Modelling with Tabular Models
result.comment: Accepted at MACLEAN 2026 (Workshop on Machine Learning for Earth Observation), held in conjunction with ECML PKDD 2026
result.summary: Surface irrigation planning requires screening many operating conditions and spatial configurations, while high-fidelity shallow-water-equation (SWE) simulations are expensive. We study tabular surrogate models for predicting maximum water height from drone-derived field morphology, terrain, hydrological, spatial, and scenario descriptors, where each row represents a spatial cell under one irrigation scenario. To assess deployment feasibility, we evaluate gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular models, AutoML, and tabular foundation models (TFMs) under two regimes: same-sector generalization, where a model predicts unseen scenarios after observing a limited set of configurations in the same sector, and sector-out transfer, where knowledge learned from source sectors is transferred to an unseen sector. The main findings are twofold: a) under the evaluated fixed 8/32 same-sector split, surrogates achieve strong performance, especially with raw spatial coordinates; b) sector-out transfer is substantially harder because the target sector has different coordinates and geometry. Sector-frame normalization of spatial coordinates improves transfer across similarly structured sectors, but does not solve cross-shape generalization. Overall, tabular surrogates appear useful for same-sector scenario screening under this fixed split, while robust transfer to unseen sectors remains open.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究灌溉代理建模：在不进行昂贵浅水方程模拟的情况下，用梯度提升树、神经表格模型、AutoML 和表格基础模型从无人机地形等描述符预测最大水深，并比较同区泛化与跨区迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于地球观测与农业规划的表格式代理建模，不涉及内部状态、latent 生成、证据获取或停止决策；其「跨区/形状泛化」与坐标归一化虽涉空间泛化，但未提供可映射到 LVR 表示或推理机制的线索，故排除。
